notes.title: Graphics Update, Thai and Spanish Support
notes.content:
Because the world needs more "kawaii", Monmusu Gladiator has received an update!

Graphics Update
The Growth Cards are even cuter now! Updated cards and their illustrators are as follows.
Ekomori Eko: Break Time, Scavenge, Triple Head, Hot Spring, Research
Gloggy: Chew Bone

Additional Language Support
Having been in the works for a while, Thai (not yet finalized) and Spanish are now supported!
Thank you to Whateverzone (Jit) for assisting with the Thai translation for several years, and to Cris Kaiju for kindly providing a Spanish translation!
Also, thank you to Tokoronyori for helping resolve several issues with implementing Thai support.

And that about sums up the contents of this update.
There might be another wonderful announcement in the near future.
Thank you everyone for your support!

If you haven't written a review yet, please consider it! It's a big help to development!

notes.title: A new collab card is here from The Lord of Borders ~Raid of Demon~!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/10075dd67ea0f53b9bffb88673c7aa9dba249467.png[/img]
"The Lord of Borders" is a building management and defense sim board game from the creators of "Space Buccaneer", tengusutan.
With a new expansion coming, "The Lord of Borders ~Raid of Demon~", a collab is happening with Monmusu Gladiator!
Shiba Inu from Monmusu Gladiator is going to be making her appearance as a Demi-human, making sure to get in the player's way.

As for the Monmusu Gladiator side of things, a new Growth Card has been added to the default starting cards, "Challenger", with art of Shiba Inu as depicted in "The Lord of Borders ~Raid of Demon~"! It looks like there might be a pretty good synergy with a certain other card...

"The Lord of Borders ~Raid of Demon~" is currently being crowdfunded on Kickstarter! Thank you in advance for any and all support! (*Rewards only ship to Japan)

Kickstarter
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tenugusutan/the-lord-of-borders-raid-of-demon


In addition, the Growth Card "Undead Beckoning" has had its effects changed so that you can no longer pull off an unlimited combo.
This problem had been pointed out before, and there were discussions in the official Discord, but the biggest reason it wasn't changed until now is that Monmusu Gladiator is a single player game. However, since this combo was possible with every 0 cost starter card, and with future cards being added in mind, we decided it should be changed. We're very sorry to anyone who had fun using it.

Also, one more thing - we had Swimmy, the one behind the designs of Vampire and Killer Doll, draw new artwork for the Growth Card "Drive".
The character on the card is part of the so-called "Demon Lord" species, but actually, that design was originally Vampire's. We'd like to eventually implement her as a raisable Monster Girl one day.
Going forward, we plan on replacing more of the existing artwork (mainly the ones by Minato Aoi) like the above.

[Release notes]
Content additions
- Added a collab Growth Card to the default starting cards

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug where using the Growth Card "Messenger" when it would empty your hand would advance you 2 spaces forward
- Fixed a bug where using the Growth Card "Dungeon Defenses" under certain circumstances wouldn't destroy any "Treasure" cards in the deck
- Fixed a bug where the amount of gold received from "The Hundred Year Kingdom" wasn't as described after reaching Rank 2
- Fixed a bug where during the "Lost Demi-human Children's Parents" event, the Growth Card "Three Lost Demi-human Children" would remain under certain cirumstances

Misc. changes
- Changed the effects of the Growth Card "Undead Beckoning", making it no longer possible to start an unlimited combo
- Updated the artwork on the Growth Card "Drive"
- Added new artwork to the title screen

notes.title: Collaboration Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/8e5a74ad2fc60e307d0d0f8e6575400d05175142.png[/img]
The collab update with over 10 other indie game titles is finally here!
While we were at it, we also added some features for our speedrunning-oriented Breeders!
Also, while it won't be until next year, we're planning on adding another Breeder Pack. We hope we'll be able to get that out to you sooner rather than later!

Content additions
- Added the collab Growth Cards to the default starting cards

Feature improvements
- On the Deck Edit screen, you can now see each Growth Card's potential drop amount
- Added an option to disable your unlocked bonuses from Breeder Packs when choosing a difficulty
- The Results screen now shows your clear time
- Added a cap to the score you can get from the "Most Damage" statistic on the Results screen

Bug fixes
- Fixed Magic Stones being able to overflow and become negative
- Fixed the "Battle Count" statistic not increasing upon clearing Rank 3
- Fixed the Growth Card "Energy Boost"'s pop-up staying stuck on the screen after choosing it with the Growth Card "Messenger"
- Fixed the effects of the Growth Card "Double Cast" not applying to the Growth Card "Hot Spring"

Misc. changes
- Updated the artwork on a handful of the original Growth Cards

notes.title: Next Update Info vol.2
notes.content:
In the next update, we'll be implementing the collab with over 10 other indie game titles!
Let's look at remaining collab titles to introduce! The update is almost here!

[h3]The rogue-like RPG "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2"[/h3]

"Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2" is a traditional rogue-like game where you adventure together with monster girls.
A rogue-like game, but with cute monster girls... It's like a dream come true for me!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/64145bca64344f5be5f5fe23aea25cc5ba149ce6.jpg[/img]
I've been a fan since the previous game in the series, and I'm happy to say that just the other day, an update featuring collab content with "Monmusu Gladiator" just went live in "Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2"!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1895860/view/3692441907949646735

A familiar girl from Monmusu Gladiator makes her appearance! There's a heart-warming story to go along with it too, so please go ahead and give it a playthrough if you'd like!

"Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2" is currently available on the Nintendo Switch, Steam, and DLsite!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895860/22/

[h3]Idle game meets monster raising meets completely free gacha in the addictive management simulation game "Monster Company"[/h3]

"Monster Company" is mobile game that you can leave idle and still feel the satisfaction of your characters continuing to grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/d865ef61bd684050eb1ecc56eb728cddb70f211f.jpg[/img]
And what's more, is that Comet and Shiba Inu are making their collab appearance! Watch out, they have really cute chibi art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/a675f073bba685a8b42def55cd63345b78c1117b.jpg[/img]
"Monster Company" can be played for free on Android and iOS!

App Store
[url=https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1334516916]https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1334516916
[/url]
Google Play

[h3]Idle game meets hack & slash meets trying to put together the best party in "Idle-style Hack & Slash Monsters"[/h3]

"Idle-style Hack & Slash Monsters" is a mobile game with strong hack & slash elements.
You'll catch yourself opening the app without even realizing it at the thought of getting rare drops of monsters, weapons, and more with a unique title drop system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/49126ff97eb014a3dc6d9a2ccfb4a58adc7524e3.png[/img]
The Dragonewt Alisa also makes her collab appearance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/a261b03cb7c12b407d55f7bfa7c66d508e834173.jpg[/img]
"Idle-style Hack & Slash Monsters" can be played for free on Android and iOS!

App Store
[url=https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1504421109]https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1504421109[/url]

Google Play
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.goronix.idlemonsters]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.goronix.idlemonsters[/url]

[h3]Build dungeons while giving monster girls love and affection in tower defense-style game "Maohslime-sama Can Do It!"[/h3]

"Maohslime-sama Can Do It!" is a mobile game where you put together a dungeon with monsters and traps and lie in wait for adventurers to wander in!
You won't be able to help but smile as you put together a well-structured dungeon and things go just according to plan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/1a9f926448a61925caadbf4a222dc0331b91b611.png[/img]

The Dragonewt Alisa also makes her collab appearance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/87453b7fd7f0d19c74242dc3f94b79bee1ffbc35.jpg[/img]

"Maohslime-sama Can Do It!" can be played for free on Android and iOS!

Maohslime-sama Can Do It!
[url=https://maohslime.com/]https://maohslime.com/[/url]

[h3]Rely too much on overwhelming demonic power and you'll lose yourself to evil in the fallen angel rogue-like "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall"[/h3]

"Lazriel: The Demon's Fall" is a rogue-like game where you balance risk and reward while fighting your way back to heaven.
You'll be forced to make difficult choices in order to avoid being consumed by the influence of overwhelming demonic power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40727085/75aa675b32149adff86a5cd23d356d9d4e20f479.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807260

"The Lord of Borders" is a board game that you can play with either one or two players.
If you like constant growth and strategic positioning of your assets, you'll definitely love this one!

notes.title: ver1.2.0公開のお知らせ
notes.content:
大型アップデート実施！
コンテストで入賞したモン娘、育成カードが新登場しました。

【コンテンツ追加】
・新規ブリーダーパック『The Chosen Heroes』を追加しました
・育成履歴を追加しました
・2つめの初期アーティファクトを追加しました
・継承システムを追加しました（機能を解放する必要があります）
・アーティファクトを入手できる宝箱マスを追加しました。
・イベントマスを追加しました
・アーティファクトショップマスを追加しました
・所持している育成カードに『ランナーズハイ』、『邪神の施し』、『エナジーブースト』を追加しました
・新たな難易度『試練6』を追加しました

【機能改善】
・デッキ編集機能を追加しデフォルトのデッキを変更しました
・報酬選択時に見られる情報を増やしました
・育成モン娘選択時に前回育成したモン娘が選択されるようにしました
・取得したGがスコアに加算されるようになりました
・戦闘後にGが取得できるようになりました
・Gを支払うことで一部の報酬を再抽選できるようにしました
・シーン遷移時の演出を改善しました
・技詳細確認時に技が与える影響の補足を表示するボタンを追加しました
・デッキ、捨て札表示を改善しました

【バランス調整】
・以下の技の性能を調整しました
パワースマッシュ
  (自)気絶 2.0s→(自)ダメージカットダウン 2.0s
石化ビーム
  命中 50→70
